name: quota-coach
description: See what is using your plan's limits and what to do about it: one-line tips, a "why did that cost so much" card, a pre-send estimate and a daily report.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto: Vietnamese when Claude Code's own language setting is Vietnamese, English otherwise (looked up once at session start). en: always English. vi: always Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).

tips.title: Show saving tips
tips.description: Shown by default. A one-line tip above the prompt when something is using your limits needlessly (a very full context, a cold cache, many subagents, a strong model on light work). Never acts by itself.

estimate.title: Show the pre-send estimate
estimate.description: Shown by default. While you type, "This turn ~3% of 5H": a guess from the size of the conversation, the model and what recent turns measured. Appears after a few turns have taught it your rate.

contextTipPercent.title: Context level for the compact tip (%)
contextTipPercent.description: How full the context window must be before the tip suggests /compact. Between 30 and 95.
